subject: Request: Hosted API evaluation for Novashops
messages:
From: Samir Khatri <samir@novashops.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Hosted API evaluation for Novashops

Hi Mina / Diego —

We signed up through the self-serve flow and want to run a short eval of the Hosted API focusing on catalog enrichment and summarization. We're a small engineering team (2 engs) and would like a 30–45 minute walkthrough plus sandbox access. Prefer mornings PST next week.

Key goals:
- Quick walkthrough of the Hosted API + rate/cost guidance for N=100k tokens/month
- Confirm sandbox access and example prompts for product descriptions
- Understand any workspace limits for ingesting product catalogs

Could you propose a few morning slots? Our lead engineer (me) is in PST.

Thanks —
Samir Khatri
Head of ML, Novashops
samir@novashops.ai
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khatri <samir@novashops.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API evaluation for Novashops

Hi Samir —

Great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a 30–45 minute Hosted API walkthrough and provision a short-lived sandbox for Novashops.

Quick questions so we scope the session:
- Do you want a 30 or 45 min slot? (30 is fine for a high-level walkthrough; 45 lets us do a quick live prompt test with your sample product CSV)
- Which morning timezone do you mean — PST? We can do 9–11am PT windows.

Propose: I can do Tue 5/18 at 9:30am PT or Wed 5/19 at 10am PT. Diego (SDR) will send the calendar invite + sandbox link once we lock a time. I’ve attached a short sandbox invite stub that lists what we provision.

Calendar link: https://cal.redwood.com/mina/30min
Sandbox preview: https://sandbox.redwood.com/novashops-guest

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Product Solutions (PLG) | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
From: Samir Khatri <samir@novashops.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API evaluation for Novashops

Thanks Mina —

9–11am PT works. If possible let's do 45 minutes (we'll bring a short CSV to test). I can't do Tue 5/18 at 9:30am (all-day offsite). Wed 5/19 at 10am PT looks good for me.

Also can you confirm the sandbox will allow bulk CSV uploads (~2k rows) and whether we need a signed NDA for sample data?

—Samir
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khatri <samir@novashops.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 May 2027 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API evaluation for Novashops

Hi Samir —

Confirmed Wed 5/19 10:00am PT (45 min). I've attached a calendar invite (calendar-propose.ics) and provisioned a temporary sandbox account — credentials and a short guide in the sandbox invite (novashops_sandbox_invite.txt). Sandbox notes:
- CSV upload: supported up to 5k rows for evaluation (we'll throttle ingestion to avoid rate limits)
- Data retention: sandbox data auto-deletes after 14 days
- If your product data is sensitive we can sign a quick mutual NDA; otherwise for synthetic/sampled data it's fine without an NDA for short evals.

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Bring one CSV (sample of product descriptions)
- Identify 1–2 prompt examples you want to test
- Share any strict redaction requirements ahead of time

Joining details: Google Meet link is in the invite. If you want us to run a small import before the meeting, upload the CSV to the sandbox link and email me the filename.

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
SDR (PLG) | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khatri <samir@novashops.ai>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API evaluation for Novashops

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Samir.

Attached is a short pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.md) and a 2–3 prompt template we typically use for product enrichment. We'll kick off with a quick architecture slide, then run live prompts against the sandbox dataset so you can see latency and output quality.

If anything changes ping Diego and he'll re-provision or reschedule. Look forward to Wednesday.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Product Solutions (PLG) | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
